S.title: Weigh the Trade-offs - Community Builders of Pecan Grove
intro: The hearing is over. Before the Town Council decides, it weighs four paths.
Every path has good parts and hard parts. Help the town see them all.
There's no wrong path. Points come from weighing well.
S.p1: Tap each signpost to weigh its good parts and hard parts.

S.tipWeigh: Next time, weigh all four paths before you choose.
S.tipGood: Next time, read the good parts slowly. Who would be glad?
S.tipHard: Next time, read the hard parts slowly. Who would feel them?
S.tipChange: Next time, pick a change that fits one of your path's hard parts.
S.tip100: Great weighing! Try a new round with a different path.
S.real: Choose something your family is deciding, like a weekend plan. Name one good part and one hard part of each choice.
S.askQ: When you make a big choice, how do you weigh the good parts and the hard parts?
S.guText: There are four paths: build as planned, build with changes, don't build here, or wait for more information. Each has gains and costs, and each can earn full points. The score rewards exploring every path and naming who gains and who finds it hard. It never rewards the path chosen.
